title: 1136-future-value-football-players
universal_lens: A unified statistical framework for predicting player value via time-normalized performance features, leveraging Lasso/RF regression with log-transformed targets across positional submodels. Log-normal value distribution with position-specific regression models using Wyscout features and league-average anchors.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian belief updating on player feature vectors using conformal predictive distributions derived from historical Wyscout and TransferMarkt datasets. Bayesian inference on player value via Lasso regression with conformal prediction intervals for uncertainty quantification.
gse_mapping: Situational state transitions in player valuation modeled as Markov processes over performance aggregates, with reward functions anchored to league-average value norms. Situational reasoning engine maps player state transitions through position-specific feature spaces with temporal validation.
